slides.title: What the assays establish
bullets: Primary potency assay: inflammatory-signal kinase response, IC50 in nM.
Selectivity sweep: inhibition at 1 µM for the representatives shown in the listing.
Check Hill slope alongside potency; compare panel profiles at the stated concentration.
Lower panel signal supports screening selectivity, not a cellular mechanism or exposure margin.
